scores.response: The punishment for identity fraud in Pakistan is provided under various sections of the Pakistan Penal Code. For instance, section 467 deals with forgery for valuable security, which includes identity documents, and provides a punishment of imprisonment for life or up to ten years, along with a fine. Section 468 addresses forgery for the purpose of cheating, punishable with imprisonment up to seven years and a fine. Section 469 covers forgery for the purpose of harming reputation, punishable with imprisonment up to three years and a fine. Additionally, section 210 deals with fraudulently obtaining a decree for a sum not due, which can involve identity fraud, and is punishable with imprisonment up to two years or a fine. Section 211 addresses false charges made with intent to injure, which can also relate to identity fraud, and is punishable with imprisonment up to two years or a fine, with harsher penalties if the false charge involves an offence punishable with death or life imprisonment.
